name: week
title: The purchasing week
subtitle: Read-only snapshot. Keep currencies separate. Comparisons are not realised savings.

sections.title: Supplier concentration
sections.sql: select * from spend.supplier_spend order by entity,currency,gross_purchases desc

sections.title: Price comparisons
sections.sql: select entity,invoice,item,uom,currency,unit_price,baseline,comparison_gap from spend.price_variance order by invoice

sections.title: Outstanding reviews
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_on from spend.reviews where status='open' order by due_on

sections.title: Evidence checks
sections.sql: select entity,invoice,rule,finding from spend.evidence_gaps order by entity,invoice

sections.title: Latest invoice dates
sections.sql: select * from spend.freshness order by entity
